steps.text: Newton 1: a body stays at rest or moves at constant velocity unless a resultant force acts.
Newton 2: F = ma — the resultant force equals mass times acceleration.
Newton 3: forces come in equal and opposite pairs acting on different bodies.
Momentum p = mv is a vector; impulse = FΔt = Δp.
In collisions the total momentum is conserved when no external resultant force acts.
Conservation is per axis: m₁u₁ + m₂u₂ = m₁v₁ + m₂v₂.
